newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Canberra says Telstra sale remains on track.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Canberra says Telstra sale remains on track.

text.p: Australian Finance Minister John Fahey said on Tuesday the government remained on track to sell one-third of telecoms carrier Telstra Corp by the end of calendar 1997.

"The government is making solid progress towards the objective of giving Australians the opportunity of investing in the biggest domestic company, which is operating in the fastest sector of our economy, namely telecommunications," Fahey told parliament. "The government is on target to have one-third of the Commonwealth's equity in Telstra available for sale before the end of this calendar year."
Last Thursday, the government announced a team of stockbrokers from around the world to manage the sale of Telstra.
The sale is expected to raise more than A$8.0 billion for the government, although Fahey last week declined to comment on his expectations regarding sale proceeds.
